name: Approval required (high-privilege)
description: For high-privilege groups (Global Administrator role groups, tenant-root owner groups, Privileged Role Administrator): inherits the v1-parity baseline from 'default' (Expiration P1D/P365D/P365D, Enablement MFA + Justification on EndUser-Assignment, Justification only on Admin-Eligibility) AND additionally requires an approval. Activation requires MFA + Justification AND an approval -- unchanged, and that is the control that matters for a high-privilege group. Admin-Eligibility carries Justification but NOT MFA, for the BUG-21 reason recorded in the 'default' template: the admin caller is the engine's app-only certificate SPN and can never present an MFA claim, so requiring one blocks every assignment and prevents nothing. Approvers = the definition row's Owners. Serial = first owner decides, escalates to the next after escalationHours; switch mode to 'Parallel' for any-one-of-the-owners-wins.
